title: Core Quartet #47
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, four women in a single row.

A photograph of FOUR women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 4 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult Iranian woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, sultry, curly hair, real living eyes. Long square nails, glittery finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a professional female bodybuilder physique carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, with the most extreme glute and hip development. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the front, side and rear deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps with a deep split between them, wide flaring lats, a deeply carved abdomen with sharp obliques, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep and a visible teardrop shape above each knee, thick hamstrings, and diamond-shaped calves. The waist is narrow only in contrast to the massive hips and shoulders. Every muscle group is separated by deep grooves and hard edges. Hard and muscular, not soft, not a plus-size body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in Cubist-fragmented pattern — sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once, wide silver bands following every deep crease, dense angular fragment planes filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward.

Far-left woman's footwear: extreme silver extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Left woman: a real adult Chinese woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, clear fair skin, a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips, long black hair loosely tousled with a few strands across the face, a dreamy, half-lidded expression, demure and soft, low bun hair, real living eyes. Long square nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a professional female bodybuilder physique carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, with the most extreme glute and hip development. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the front, side and rear deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps with a deep split between them, wide flaring lats, a deeply carved abdomen with sharp obliques, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep and a visible teardrop shape above each knee, thick hamstrings, and diamond-shaped calves. The waist is narrow only in contrast to the massive hips and shoulders. Every muscle group is separated by deep grooves and hard edges. Hard and muscular, not soft, not a plus-size body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Escher-inspired tessellation — a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense morphing tessellation filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.

Left woman's footwear: extreme gold ankle-strap stilettos, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Egyptian woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, sultry, curly hair, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, holographic finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an enormous, overwhelmingly powerful woman. Colossal thick trapezius muscle rising high around her neck, massive round boulder shoulders, enormous thick arms with dense hard muscle, a broad powerful back, a deeply carved abdomen, colossal glutes and hips extending far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep sweep. Her head looks small on top of her massive frame. Not slim, not a fitness body, powerful and heavy at once. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Swedish Dalarna kurbits folk painting — a deep barn-red ground with bold cream and gold curling scrollwork, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense curling floral scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward.

Right woman's footwear: extreme gold extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Far-right woman: a real adult Russian woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, very fair, cool skin, sculpted feathered dark brows, a precise winged liner, soft taupe eyeshadow, long lashes, large pale eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour and a bright highlighter along the cheekbones and nose bridge, glossy nude-pink lips, long straight platinum-blonde hair, a cold, striking expression, bold and confident, elegant updo hair, real living eyes. Long round nails, glossy finish.

Far-right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-right woman's body art: painted in Polish Bolesławiec pottery — a deep cobalt ground with bold white peacock-eye dot motifs, wide white bands following every deep crease, dense peacock-eye dot motifs filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-right woman's pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera.

Far-right woman's footwear: extreme white platform stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 4, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 landscape 8K.
